verify_checks.name: the attributions table exists and is empty (the switches are off: nothing is attributed)
the agent and its version are columns of the hypotheses and of the experiments
verify_checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'analytics' and table_name in ('research_hypotheses', 'experiments') and column_name in ('agent', 'agent_version')

verify_checks.name: the gate A verdict recorded on 3 Nov is still the newest row of its gate
verify_checks.sql: select passed from ai.feature_gates where gate = 'gate_a' order by at desc, id desc limit 1

verify_checks.name: no promotion of an agent was written by the deploy
verify_checks.sql: select count(*) from intel.promotions where entity = 'agent' and at >= '@DEPLOY_STARTED@'
